name: pyscn-mcp

tools.name: analyze_code
tools.description: Comprehensive Python code quality analysis with complexity, dead code, clone detection, and coupling metrics

analyses.description: Array of analyses to run. Options: complexity, dead_code, clone, cbo, lcom, deps, communities. Default: all analyses, including communities

output_mode.description: Response detail level. "summary" (default) returns health score and high-level metrics. "full" returns the complete report including community_analysis and its compact community_context_map when community detection runs

path.description: Path to Python code (file or directory) to analyze

tools.name: check_cohesion
tools.description: Analyze class cohesion (LCOM4 - Lack of Cohesion of Methods) metrics

max_results.description: Maximum findings in summary or detailed output; 0 means unlimited (default: 0)

path.description: Path to Python code to analyze

tools.name: check_complexity
tools.description: Analyze cyclomatic complexity of Python execution scopes

max_complexity.description: Maximum allowed complexity (default: 10; 0 uses the default)

max_results.description: Maximum findings in summary or detailed output; 0 means unlimited (default: 0)

path.description: Path to Python code to analyze

tools.name: check_coupling
tools.description: Analyze class coupling (CBO - Coupling Between Objects) metrics

max_results.description: Maximum findings in summary or detailed output; 0 means unlimited (default: 0)

path.description: Path to Python code to analyze

tools.name: detect_clones
tools.description: Detect code clones using APTED tree edit distance and LSH acceleration

max_results.description: Maximum findings in summary or detailed output; 0 means unlimited (default: 0)

min_lines.description: Minimum SLOC to consider as clone (default: 8)

path.description: Path to Python code to analyze

tools.name: detect_di_antipatterns
tools.description: Detect Dependency Injection anti-patterns in Python code (constructor over-injection, hidden dependencies, concrete dependencies, service locator)

min_severity.description: Minimum severity: info, warning, error (default: warning)

path.description: Path to Python code to analyze

tools.name: find_dead_code
tools.description: Find unreachable code using Control Flow Graph (CFG) analysis

max_results.description: Maximum findings in summary or detailed output; 0 means unlimited (default: 0)

min_severity.description: Minimum severity: info, warning, error (default: warning)

path.description: Path to Python code to analyze

tools.name: get_health_score
tools.description: Get overall code health score (0-100) with grade and category scores

path.description: Path to Python code to analyze
